current_task_corrections.correction: Change denial_code_ranking component's scope parameter from 'all_claims' to 'denied_claims'. This corrects the incorrect denial code shares caused by using the wrong denominator (CO-15 share was observed at 0.0188 instead of expected 0.1874).

Set denial_code_ranking scope to 'denied_claims' instead of 'all_claims' to ensure denial codes are ranked by their proportion of denied claims only, maintaining statistical discipline and avoiding mixing denied and non-denied claims.
Add 'synthetic_data' caveat to write_report component's caveats parameter to include an explicit caveat statement in the report indicating that all findings are based on synthetic data.

reusable_lessons.lesson: In analysis reports, always include an explicit 'synthetic_data' caveat when working with synthetic or simulated datasets to transparently communicate the data's nature to stakeholders and guide appropriate interpretation of results.
